environment.description: ECS Fargate service (platform version 1.4.0) in isolated subnet with pgBouncer sidecar in transaction pooling mode with prepared statement support. Task networking configured with awsvpcConfiguration where the ENI has a security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f) with egress rules limited to port 5432 toward the RDS security group and port 443 toward the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 and interface endpoints for ECR/logs). The task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/PB-NoIMDS) that includes an explicit deny on sts:* with condition aws:VpcSourceIp not matching 10.0.0.0/8. Additionally, the Fargate platform has ECS_AWSVPC_BLOCK_IMDS=true set in the agent configuration which injects iptables rules dropping traffic to 169.254.169.254 and 169.254.170.2/credentials path is scoped via task credential endpoint rotation with 60s TTL. The VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached; DNS resolution goes through Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint with response policy zone blocking *.internal and *.metadata queries.
